req.title: Reject invalid date-of-birth format
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-024 requires HTTP 422 when dateOfBirth cannot be parsed as ISO-8601 date. Examining the source: PlayerRequestModel.date_of_birth is Optional[str] with no Pydantic validator enforcing ISO-8601 format — the field accepts any string. This means the SUT as written will NOT reject invalid date strings at the Pydantic layer; it will accept them and return 201. The tests must reflect the actual requirement (422 expected) and will kill mutants that add/remove/alter a validator. We cover: (1) positive — valid ISO-8601 date accepted (201), (2) negative — clearly invalid format rejected (422), (3) boundary — date-like but non-ISO string (e.g. DD/MM/YYYY) rejected (422), (4) negative — completely non-date string rejected (422), (5) boundary — ISO-8601 datetime vs date-only. Squad numbers 27+ are used for POST to avoid 409 conflicts with the 26 pre-loaded rows.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201
preconditions: App is running in-process via TestClient
Squad number 27 does not exist in the database
dateOfBirth is a valid ISO-8601 date string: 1990-06-15
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid payload where dateOfBirth='1990-06-15'
expected: Response body contains firstName, lastName, squadNumber matching the request
Response body contains dateOfBirth equal to '1990-06-15'
trace: R-PLAYER-024: valid ISO-8601 date must be accepted (positive partition)
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15",
        "squadNumber": 27,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 27
    assert body["dateOfBirth"] == "1990-06-15"

test_post_player_valid_iso8601_date_returns_201()
